reason: I'd maybe try the free part out of curiosity, but I'm not linking my bank account to a brand new app from one developer with zero reviews. And I'm definitely not paying for Pro before I even know if I'll open it after the first week.
objection: My bank data sitting with a solo developer, with nobody I can go to if something leaks or the app just shuts down in six months.
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust using it for a few months and saying it actually showed them where their salary goes, plus clear proof the bank link is read-only through a registered Account Aggregator and that I can delete everything any time.
